sv.title: Carolina Klüft: Barns hälsa kan inte vänta
sv.summary: Regeringsbildningen kan dra ut på tiden. Barndomen gör det inte. Barnkonventionen slår fast barns rätt till trygghet, utveckling, delaktighet och att barnets bästa ska sättas i främsta rummet. Nu behöver de rättigheterna omsättas i handling, skriver Carolina Klüft verksamhetschef Generation Pep.

en.title: Carolina Klüft: Children's health cannot wait
en.summary: Government formation may drag on. Childhood does not. The Convention on the Rights of the Child establishes children's right to security, development and participation, and that the best interests of the child shall be the primary consideration. Now those rights need to be put into action, writes Carolina Klüft, head of operations at Generation Pep.
